newsitem.title: ESTONIA: FOREKS CLOSES ST. PETERSBURG ACCOUNTS.
newsitem.headline: FOREKS CLOSES ST. PETERSBURG ACCOUNTS.

text.p: Estonia's Forekspank has closed its corresponding accounts in St. Petersburg banks pending an arbitration court hearing in St. Petersburg, the bank said on Tuesday.
Forekspank issued instructions to the St. Petersburg banks to close the accounts, it said in a statement.
The St. Petersburg and Leningrad Oblast Arbitration court will review the decision of the St. Petersburg tax police to freeze Forekspank's accounts on September 16.
The tax police froze the accounts of several Baltic banks on July 31, but the banks were able to free the accounts by August 7.
Forekspank will be seeking damages from the tax police for its decision to freeze the accounts, the bank said.
